protocol.primary_metric: Exact duration major/minor accuracy including reference N.
protocol.root_metric: Correct root, ignoring major/minor quality, over supported reference chord duration only. Reference N is excluded; predicting N on a chord is an error.
protocol.reference_policy: Between first and last annotated beats only; NC is interpreted as N under the unchanged adapter; unsupported symbols and unannotated audio are excluded.
protocol.runtime: Uncached audio loading, resampling, tuning, RMS, required spectral features, dictionary construction, projection or NNLS, Viterbi decoding and interval construction. Imports, warm-up, raw diagnostics, scoring, hashes and output are excluded. The OS disk cache is retained.
protocol.grouping: Each fast piece ID is paired with the same ID in the already evaluated slow branch. Recordings are new tempo renditions, not independent new compositions or unseen progressions.
protocol.decision: One frozen comparison. No parameter search, threshold adjustment or automatic default replacement follows this test.
